The CFTC Just Published Its First Crypto Market Rulebook

The CFTC published a notice on October 5 opening a 60-day
comment period on federal rules for retail crypto transactions
and a new voluntary "crypto asset market" registration category.
Chairman Michael Selig said the goal is to prevent fraudulent
schemes like FTX before they happen.

The move follows the Senate's failure to advance the CLARITY Act
on September 15.
